$comment: AUTHORITY for the words of a Worker service's refusals to start, of the errors it fails a job with, and of the messages it logs that a reader of its output relies on (WORKER-SERVICE.md), word for word. A text's `{name}` is filled as the row's `situation` says, and nothing else in it varies; a hole whose words the situation says vary is some text on one line. `boot` is each refusal to start, written in service-environment/boot-refusals.json's `line`, once, to stderr, before the service exits with that table's `exitCode`: a row that names `bootRefusal` is that table's refusal of that name, its `{service}` `worker` and its `{schema}` `WorkerConfig`; any other row is the worker's own. `reasons` is each line of the `{reasons}` of `invalid`. `job` is how an error names the job, by its type, as `{job}`. `errors` is each error a job is failed with whose words a clause of WORKER-SERVICE.md names; an error no clause names is the implementation's to word; an error that repeats what another said (the record's refusal of a resource or of a commit, the claim's of a job the worker stopped holding) is that one's words, not these. `logged` is each message a Worker service logs, at its `level`, with the facts named in `fields`, each of the form given, and the facts named in `carries` beside them.

boot.name: unnamed
boot.situation: Started without `--config <path>` or `--config=<path>` naming a path.

boot.name: unreadable
boot.situation: The path names no file the service can read.

boot.name: invalid
boot.situation: The document is not a WorkerConfig: `{path}` is the path as it was given, and `{reasons}` one line of `reasons`, for the first way it is not.
boot.refusal:
{path} is not a worker configuration document (WorkerConfig):
{reasons}

boot.name: key-unset
boot.refusal: XYNOLOG_OIDC_CLIENT_KEY is not set in the worker's environment: a worker signs in as a service account

boot.name: key-unreadable
boot.situation: `XYNOLOG_OIDC_CLIENT_KEY` is not a PEM private key the service can read without a passphrase.
boot.refusal: XYNOLOG_OIDC_CLIENT_KEY in the worker's environment is not an unencrypted PEM private key

boot.name: key-not-rsa
boot.situation: `XYNOLOG_OIDC_CLIENT_KEY` is a private key that is not RSA.
boot.refusal: XYNOLOG_OIDC_CLIENT_KEY in the worker's environment is not an RSA key: a worker signs its assertions with RS256

boot.name: api-key-unset
boot.situation: An engine names, by its `apiKeyEnv`, a variable that is unset or empty: `{knowledgeBase}` is the index of its knowledge base in `knowledgeBases`, and `{engine}` its index in that one's `engines`, each in decimal digits.
boot.refusal: knowledgeBases[{knowledgeBase}].engines[{engine}].apiKeyEnv names a variable that is not set in the worker's environment

boot.name: domain-twice
boot.situation: Two of `knowledgeBases` name one `domain`: `{later}` is the index of the later, and `{earlier}` of the earlier, each in decimal digits.
boot.refusal: knowledgeBases[{later}].domain is the domain of knowledgeBases[{earlier}]: a worker serves a knowledge base once

boot.name: none-admits
boot.situation: Every knowledge base refused the service before any was confirmed.
boot.refusal: No knowledge base admits this worker: each of its knowledgeBases refused it

boot.name: cannot-listen
boot.situation: The service cannot listen on its `port`: `{port}` is the port, in decimal digits, and `{why}` the system's reason, which varies.

reasons.name: missing
reasons.situation: An object without a member its schema requires: `{member}` is the member's name.

reasons.name: other
reasons.situation: Any other way the document is not its schema's: `{member}` is the names on the way from the document to the member, joined by `.`, with no index of an array.
reasons.line: {member}: is not what the schema states

errors.name: unextractable
errors.situation: A job on a resource whose media type has no text the worker can read: `{resourceId}` is the resource, and `{mediaType}` its media type.
errors.error: Cannot run {job} on resource {resourceId}: media type '{mediaType}' has no extractable text to analyze

errors.name: not-settled
errors.situation: A job on a resource whose anchored text the Smelter has not yet settled: `{resourceId}` is the resource.
errors.error: Anchored text not yet derived for resource {resourceId} — Smelter has not settled; retrying

errors.name: anchored-declined
errors.situation: A job on a resource the anchored-text consult declines: `{resourceId}` is the resource, and `{declined}` what the consult answered, `no-map` or `unknown`.
errors.error: Cannot run {job} on resource {resourceId}: anchored-text consult returned '{declined}'

errors.name: not-served
errors.situation: A job of a motivation the engine that took it does not serve.

errors.name: no-processor
errors.situation: A tagging job handed over without the schema it names.

errors.name: window-too-small
errors.situation: A model whose window leaves a piece 64 tokens or fewer: `{contextTokens}` is the window, `{scaffoldTokens}` the tokens of the prompt without its piece, and `{inputBudget}` what is left, each in decimal digits.
errors.error: Inference window too small for detection: context {contextTokens} tokens minus scaffold {scaffoldTokens} leaves an input budget of {inputBudget} (need > 64). Use a model with a larger context window or reduce the prompt scaffold.

errors.name: ollama-refused
errors.situation: An Ollama engine's generation refused: `{status}` is the status, and `{body}` the body, as it was sent.

errors.name: anthropic-refused
errors.situation: An Anthropic engine's request refused: `{said}` is what its client says of the refusal, which varies, and carries the refusal's status and the words of its body's `error.message`.

errors.name: unreadable
errors.situation: An answer that cannot be read: `{detail}` is one of `details`, and `{stopReason}` why the model stopped, `end_turn` where an Ollama engine's says `stop`.
errors.error: Structured response could not be read: {detail} (stop_reason: {stopReason})

errors.name: wait-stated
errors.situation: A refusal whose stated wait is over 120 seconds: `{failure}` is the refusal's error, `anthropic-refused` or `anthropic-limits-refused`, and `{said}` one of `waits`.
errors.error: {failure}; the provider said to wait ({said}), which is longer than the 120 seconds this driver waits

errors.name: withheld
errors.situation: An answer the provider withheld: `{why}` is ` ({category})` where it states a category and `: {explanation}` where it states an explanation, in that order, each left out where it states none.
errors.error: The provider withheld its answer: refusal{why}

errors.name: no-structured-outputs
errors.situation: A mark job on an Anthropic model the Models API does not report strict structured outputs for: `{model}` is the model.
errors.error: Model '{model}' does not report support for strict structured outputs (Models API capabilities.structured_outputs). It is refused: a generation the provider does not hold to the schema can come back unreadable. Give the agent that does this work a model that reports supported: true.

errors.name: ollama-limits-refused
errors.situation: `/api/show` refused: `{model}` is the model, `{status}` the status, and `{said}` the body, as it was sent.
errors.error: Failed to discover model limits for '{model}' from Ollama's /api/show: refused with status {status}: {said}

errors.name: anthropic-limits-refused
errors.situation: The Models API refused: `{model}` is the model, `{status}` the status, and `{said}` what `anthropic-refused` says of the refusal.
errors.error: Failed to discover model limits for '{model}' from the Models API: refused with status {status}: {said}

errors.name: no-context-length
errors.situation: `/api/show` answered with no context length: `{model}` is the model.

errors.name: unsupported-output
errors.situation: A yield job for a media type the worker does not generate: `{mediaType}` is the job's `outputMediaType`, and `{generatable}` each media type media-types/registry.json says is generatable, in its order, joined by ` or `.
errors.error: Unsupported outputMediaType for generation: {mediaType}. Generation produces {generatable}.

errors.name: over-window
errors.situation: A yield job whose prompt and length are together over its model's window: `{promptTokens}` is the tokens of the prompt, `{maxTokens}` the job's `maxTokens`, `{model}` the model, and `{contextTokens}` its window, each number in decimal digits.
errors.error: The prompt (~{promptTokens} tokens) and the {maxTokens} tokens asked for are together over the context window of '{model}' ({contextTokens} tokens)

details.name: not-json
details.situation: An answer that is not JSON.

details.name: not-array
details.situation: An answer that is JSON and not an array: `{kind}` is what it is, `object`, `string`, `number`, `boolean` or `null`.

waits.name: seconds
waits.situation: A `retry-after` of `{seconds}`, as it was sent.

waits.name: milliseconds
waits.situation: A `retry-after-ms` of `{milliseconds}`, as it was sent.

logged.name: confirmed
logged.situation: A knowledge base confirmed: `{domain}` is its domain, and `{did}` the DID it names the worker by.

logged.name: refused
logged.situation: A knowledge base that refused the worker: `{domain}` is its domain. `reason` says why.

logged.name: trouble
logged.situation: A knowledge base in trouble, which the worker starts again: `{domain}` is its domain. `error` says what the trouble was, and `waitMs` how long it waits, in milliseconds.
logged.message: Knowledge base in trouble — starting it again
